notes.text:
critically examine on merit--Missing Base Pada Saṃjñā (Engine Defect)
Step: Missing (should be around #54)
Sūtra involved: 1.4.17 स्वादिष्वसर्वनामस्थाने.
Issue: The engine correctly assigns the pada designation to the entire word (rāmasu) via 1.4.14 (सुप्तिङन्तं पदम्) at step #54. However, it fails to assign the pada designation to the base/stem (rāma) preceding the suffix. According to 1.4.17, any base preceding a consonant-initial svādi affix (which is not a sarvanāmasthāna) must independently receive the pada designation.
Classification: Engine defect (Minor in this specific trace). Because rāmeṣu does not require stem-final pada operations (like 8.2.7 na-lopa), the derivation survives. However, missing 1.4.17 is a systemic structural gap for consonant-initial affixes.
